comments.name: 老骥伏枥

comments.name: GlobalNomad
comments.content: Reading about iA Writer not embracing AI is quite interesting. In Silicon Valley, everything is about integrating AI, even for established tools. It's a bold move, maybe even a smart one, to stick to core competencies. But the "诗经山河图" using AI? That's definitely more innovative, bridging ancient culture with modern tech, which is a big trend in China now. Overseas, we see similar attempts, but often lack the deep cultural context. The remote control App from NetEase UU, reminds me of TeamViewer or AnyDesk, but I wonder if its performance and security are up to global standards. It's always a challenge for Chinese apps to gain international trust, despite often having more features.

comments.name: 力的平衡点
comments.content: 赛车进站的时间账，说白了就是动能损失与势能储备的博弈。体态不良那部分，实际上是重力矩对脊椎的力矩失衡。同学们，生活处处是物理。物理不好，赛车都开不明白。

comments.name: 风清扬

comments.name: 奋斗在后厂村
comments.content: 这次少数派的年度更新，本质上是在构建一个基于共识的热爱闭环。我们需要思考的是，如何通过底层逻辑的重构，去赋能这些细分场景的颗粒度。比如那个E-cise体态管理，其实就是一种对身体心智的对齐。但说实话，看着这些App更新我挺焦虑的，现在的工具赛道已经极度内卷，如果不能在AI大模型的赋能下找到差异化的切入点，很难在存量市场里分到一杯羹。我们需要的是更深层次的链路打通，而不是简单的功能堆砌。🙃
